options.label: Any%
options.rule: Go to credits as fast as possible.

subcategories.label: Zipless
subcategories.rule: The use of zips is prohibited.

subcategories.label: No Major Glitches
subcategories.rule:
The use of major glitches is prohibited. The following are considered major glitches:
- Zips
- Rewind Tricks
- First Person glitches (e.g., box teleport, ledge turning).
  - Roll cancelling, however, is not considered a first person glitch.
- Lever glitches (instant lever turning)
- Boosts (e.g. damage boosts, box boosts)
- Invisible sword glitch
- Invisible ledges
- Zombie Glitch (Prince having 0 health without being dead)
- Trap fall damage cancel
- Enemy clipping
- Ledge storage
- Canceling a wallrun by pausing

The glitches are also explained in [this](https://www.speedrun.com/pop_sot/guide/6lrg7) guide.
